ios.desc:
Every currency you care about, on one screen, always live.

Denom is a currency converter built around a simple idea: you shouldn't convert one currency at a time. Track dollars, euros, yen, bitcoin, and stablecoins in a single list — type an amount once and watch every row update on each keystroke.

WHY DENOM

• One list, every rate. Fiat and crypto side by side — no mode toggles, no pair switching.
• Type real math. 100 × 1.2 + 50 works right in the amount field. The whole list recalculates live.
• Built for travel. Last-known rates are cached, so Denom keeps working on the plane, in the metro, or on a dead SIM.
• Quickly see rates at a glance on the Home and Locked Screens Widgets.
• Fast by design. Custom keypad, monospaced tabular numbers, haptic feedback, dark-first interface that follows your system appearance.

RATES YOU CAN TRUST

Fiat rates come from the European Central Bank and 40+ central banks. Crypto prices are provided by CoinGecko and refresh continuously while the app is open. A subtle footer always shows how fresh your data is.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT

No accounts. No analytics. No tracking. Your currencies and amounts never leave your phone.

DENOM PRO

The free app includes 3 tracked currencies. A single one-time purchase — no subscription — unlocks unlimited currencies forever.

Denom is a utility for viewing exchange rates. It is not a wallet and offers no trading, portfolio tracking, or investment functionality.
